tei:div.tei:p: (497)gzhi gsum gyi cho ga thar gling bgrod pa'i gru chen gyi zin bris kun mkhyen zhal lung bdud rtsi'i thigs pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// (498)

na ma sarba dz+nyā ya/ dge legs yon tan kun kyi gter// srid mtshor bying ba rnams kyi skyabs// kun mkhyen 'gro ba'i bla ma la// rtag tu dang bas phyag byas te// nyes brgya'i chu gter rab brgal nas// thar pa'i gling du bgrod byed pa'i// bslab pa yongs sbyong gzhi gsum gyi// zin bris blo dman 'jug bder spel// 'di la gsum/ gso sbyong*/ dbyar gnas/ dgag dbye'o// dang po la/ sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang po ni/ thog mar dus nges pa'i phyir smyig ma'i thur ma bco lnga srad bu la brgyus pa gtsug lag khang gi gdong gral gyi mjug gi ka ba'i bar du thad kar brgyangs pa nyin re bzhin dge skos sam khang skyong gis ma nor bar brtags shing bgrang dgos te/ bco lnga pa dang bcu bzhi pa ngos 'dzin tshul go sla bar brjod na/ lung las/ rgyal dang dbo dang sa ga dang*// chu stod chu smad smin drug bcas// 'di rnams kyi ni nag po'i phyogs// zla phyed gso sbyong bcu bzhi pa// lhag ma rnamasani bco lnga pa'o// zhes pa ltar/ hor zla dang po/ gsum pa/ lnga pa/ bdun pa/ dgu pa/ bcu gcig pa rnams kyi mar ngo'i gso sbyong bcu bzhi pa yin/ de ma gtogs lhag ma thams cad gso sbyong bco lnga pa sha stag (499) yin pas dus nges par bya'o// de nas bco lnga pa'am bcu bzhi pa gang yin yang*/ de'i dus la bab pa'i snga dro'i tshe dge 'dun gyi zhal ta pa dang*/ khang skyong sogs kyis gtsug lag khang byi dor legs par byed cing*/ mdo 'don pa po'i khri'i g.yas phyogs su ston pa'i sku gzugs khri la spyan drangs shing*/ gzhan yang gnas brtan bcu drug dang mdzad bcu sogs kyis zhal thang bkod legs par bya/ de dag gi mdun du mchod stegs bang rim gsum pa/ rdul dang dri mas ma sbags par 'od chags pa'i bang rim gong mar/ zhal zas kyi grangs bco lnga las mi nyung ba dang*/ bang rim bar mar chu nas spel ma bdun cha gnyis dang*/

de'i 'og mar mar me bco lnga sbreng tshar du bshams pa bkod pa'i khyad par du'aphags par bya'o// de'i 'og tu stegs cung dma' ba la/ gnyug mar gnas pa'i lha dang 'phrog ma sogs kyi gtor ma dkar zlum mtheb ril can chang bu bzhis bskor ba bkod/ mdo 'don pa po'i mdun ngos su de la zhal phyogs pa'i thad gral dge 'dun gyi gdan dang*/ dge tshul rnams kyang phyi rim du gdan bkod byas nas/ gtsug lag khang gi nang g.yas phyogs su phyir bcos dus bzhugs sa'i gral gdan thur gral zhal sprad du ring po bshams/ dge 'dun rnams so so'i gung tshigs sogs gnang zin nas/ dge slong glo bur du lhags pa yod na de rnams bsgugs nas nyi ma phyi dro la bab (500) pa na/ dung pa gnyis kyis chos gos gyon/ spin bad kha nas gding ba bzhi bltab tu bting nas/ gzan zlum khyer gyis 'greng ste/ dung skad dkyus ma dang*/ gzhan gsum bsgrigs dung skad kyis 'bud/ de yang dung brda' dang dung dang po gnyis kyi bar du sgrol ma tshar bdun dal 'don tsam dang*/ dung gzhan gsum po re re'i bar du sgrol ma tshar lnga dal 'don tsam gyi bar thag yod par byas nas/ dung gnyis pa'i dus gaṇ+ḍi brdung ba dang*/ dge 'dun 'dus par bya/ gsum pa'i dus nang du phyir bcos bya/ gaṇ+ḍi brdung ba po dge tshul slong gang rung ngam/ dge bsnyen gso sbyong la gnas pas kyang rung ste/ sgo khang du gaṇ+ḍi stegs la bkod bzhin pa de la dmigs nas/ dkon mchog gi yon tan yid la byas te gding ba bting nas chos gos bgos te phyag gsum 'tshal/ phyag gi dus gding ba ring bting dang*/ gaṇ+ḍi brdung dus bzhib ltab tu bya dgos/ de rjes gaṇ+ḍi blangs te lag g.yon pas rked pa nas btegs pa'i sne phrag g.yon du bzhag ste shad tsa zhes grags pa lag g.yas kyis brdung dbyug gi shad gsum sngon du 'gro bas las kyi gaṇ+ḍi rgyud gcig dang tog gsum pa brdung bas dge 'dun bsdu bar bya'o//

rgyud gcig ni/ bar thag la nye ring med kyang gcig nas bco brgyad bar la rim gyis sgra je cher brdung ba dang*/ bcu dgu nas so drug gi bar sgra chung ngu brdung ba ste/ de 'dra ba la rgyud (501) gcig zer ba yin/ tog gsum ni/ de rjes su cung zad dal bas sgra drag la che ba gsum brdung ba yin no// gaṇ+ḍi ma rdzogs gong du sgo khang du tshogs grub dgos pas/ der dge 'dun pa thams cad kyis mthang sham dang rngul gzan sngar nas bzhes yod thog bla gos phrag g.yon la gong ba mdun du bstan nas bkal/ gding ba bzhi bltab tu byas nas phyag g.yon par bkal/ snam sbyar gtur bur bcug pa yin na phrag tu bkal/ dpe ras su dril ba yin na gding ba'i thog tu lag g.yon par thogs/ spyod lam zhi dul dang ldan pas 'dug par bya'o// gtsug lag gi sgo khang du phebs dus mkhan pos bla gos gyon pas thog drangs kun kyis mnab par bya'o// mchil lham phud/ de nas yar phebs pa dang*/ sgo g.yas g.yon du dge tshul chab ril ba gnyis gding ba bzhi bltabs khar chos gos dang gzan zlum khyer gyis ril ba dang bzaid zhal bsnams nas chab 'bul ba bzhes nas lhag ma bzed zhal du dor/ dge slong rnams kyis re re bzhin nas gaṇ+ḍi pa la rkang lag 'dud rgya dang bcas/ gaṇ+ḍi ci'i phyir zhes dris pa'i lan du/ des kyang gso sbyong gi phyir ro// zhes lan gdab pa dang*/ nang du go rim ma 'chol bar phebs/ dge slong rnams rdzogs pa dang sgo bcad/ dge tshul rnams re zhig sgo'i phyi rol sgo khang du (502) bzhugs/ gtsug lag khang gi lho ngos su gral gdan la mkhan pos thog drangs/ bslab pa rgan pa rnams kyis gding ba tshar bu steng du phog pa'i bzhi bltabs byas pa'i dras g.yon du bstan nas bting ba'i khar pus btsugs sor bsnol mdzad nas g.yas gral du bzhugs/ dge slong rnams kyi phyed ka bslab pa gzhon pa rnams g.yon phyogs gral gdan gyi khar gding ba ring brkyang bting ba'i steng 'greng nas phyag gsum 'tshal te gzan gal khyer rkang lag 'dud rgya dang bcas gral 'gor 'khod pa des bskul nas/

bstan pa rin po che'i gsal byed dam par gyur pa btsun pa 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po ltung ba phyir bcos kyi cho ga la thugs gtad par zhu/ rgan gral rnams nas lag g.yas bkan pa dang bcas bzhin/ mkhan pos/ chos bzhin 'dul ba bzhin gnang bar zhu/ zhes lan gdab/ de mthar thams cad tsog pur bzhugs nas/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams dgongs su gsol/ bdag shākya'i dge slong thub bstan= zhes bgyi ba/ byis pa nyid dang*/ mi shes pa nyid dang*/ ma gus pa dang*/ bag ma mchis pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa mang ba'i dbang gis pham lhag gi sbom po lci yang gnyis dang*/ ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dang*/ so sor bshags par bya ba dang*/ nyes byas kyi sde tshan rnams las kha na ma tho ba gang dang gang byung ba de dag pa'i mtha' tshun chad nas bzung ste btsun pa rnams kyi mdun du mthol lo 'chags so// mthol (503)zhing bshags na bdag bde ba la reg par gnas par 'gyur gyi/ ma mthol ma bshags na ni mi 'gyur ro// yang dge 'dun btsun pa nas lan gsum bskyar mthar/ rgan gral rnams kyi lag rgya gong ltar dang*/ mkhan pos/ nyes ltung de dag la nyes ltung de dag tu gzigs lags sam/ zhes 'dri/ gzhon gral ba kun nas/ mthong lags zhu/ mkhan pos/ phyin chad legs par sdom lags sam/ zhes dri/ gzhon gral ba kun nas/ sdom lags/ zhu/ mkhan pos/ thabs yin no// gsungs/ gzhon gral ba kun nas/ legs so// zhu/ de ma thag bzhengs nas phyag gsum 'tshal nas gzan gal khyer rkang lag 'dud rgya dang bcas/ bstan pa rin po che gsal byed dam par gyur pa btsun pa 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po ltung ba phyir bcos kyi cho ga la thugs gtad pa bka' drin che lags/ zhes brjod/ mkhan pos/ chos bzhin 'dul ba bzhin gnang ba la rjes su yi rang*/ zhes gsung*/ yang phyag gsum dang 'greng ste 'dud rgya dang bcas/ bstan pa rin po che gsal byed dam par gyur pa/ ltung ba byin rlabs kyi cho ga la thugs gtad par zhu/ byas rjes/

mkhan po'i zhal snga nas/ chos bzhin 'dul ba bzhin gnang bar zhu/ gzhon gral ba rnams tsog pur 'dud pa dang bcas/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams dgongs su gsol/ bdag shākya'i dge slong thub bstan= zhes bgyi ba byis pa nyid dang*/ mi (504)shes pa nyid dang*/ ma gus pa nyid dang*/ bag ma mchis pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa mang ba'i dbang gis/ dge 'dun lhag ma'i chos bcu gsum dang*/ spang ltung sum cu las gang yang rung ba byung ba de/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams kyi mdun du byin gyis brlab bo// deng ltung ba de byin gyis brlabs te dge 'dun gyis gso sbyong mdzad la/ slad kyi ltung ba de chos bzhin du slar bgyi'o// zhes pa dang*/ dge 'dun btsun pa nas slar bgyi'o bar lan gsum bzlas/ thabs legs bya/ slar phyag dang spyod lam sngar bzhin gyis/ bstan pa rin po che= ltung ba byin brlabs kyi cho ga la thugs gtad pa bka' drin che lags/ zhes brjod/ mkhan pos/ chos bzhin 'dul ba bzhin gnang ba la rjes su yi rang*/ lan byin/ de ltar grub nas gzhon gral ba rnams kyi gding ba bzhi lteb kyi khar pus btsug dang sor bsnol gyis bzhugs/ de nas mkhan po sogs rgan pa rnams bzhengs nas gzan shad gsum dang gzan gal khyer gyis/ bstan pa rin po che sogs gong ltar bya zhing*/ gzhon gyi thog mar 'khod pa des lan zhu zhing*/ lan gyi tshe phyag g.yas thal bkas gyis zhe sa'i tshul du/ rjes su yi rang zhes pa'i tshab tu/ chos bzhin 'dul ba bzhin gnang ba bka' drin che lags/ zhes pa lta bu las gzhan gong dang 'dra/ 'di'i ring la dge tshul rnams mthong thos kyi nye 'khor las bkar te phyi (505) rol tu bzhugs pa las/ phyir bcos zin nas/ sgo phyes te brda' dang bstun nang du phebs pa la/ mkhan po nas rgan rim mthar chags su phebs te/ sngar bshams pa'i gdan la go rim ma 'chol bar gding ba ring rkyang bting ba'i steng phyag gsum kun bsgrigs par byas nas/

gzan zlum khyer gyis pus btsugs dang sor bsnol bcas 'khod/ de nas byang 'dren pas bskul te/ thams cad kyis phyag thal mo sbyar bzhin/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// sogs tshigs bcad gcig pa dang*/ tshigs bcad bzhi pa res mos bya'o// de nas so thar sdom rgyun gsol 'debs/ mtshan dpe'i gzugs sku= gsungs nas/ rtag tu bzod pa'i go cha bgo bar shog / ces pa'i dus tsam nas dge skos kyis snam sbyar bzhes/ bag yod mthun pa'i rlung gis tshul khrims gzings// zhes pa'i skabs su/ gzhan rnams kyis mnyam du snam sbyar bzhes/ dge skos kyis rang gral de nyid nas 'don pa dal myur bstun nas phyag gsum 'tshal te rdzogs pa dang gzan gal khyer rka lag 'dud rgya dang bcas/ bstan pa rin po che'i rtsa lag dam par gyur pa don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te mkhan po 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po thub bstan/ zhes bgyi ba'i zhal snga nas gtsor mdzad dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsaul/ deng zla ba yar gyi ngo'i gral tshes bco lnga pa'am/ mar gyi (506)ngo'i gral tshes bcu bzhi pa'am bco lnga pa mngon du gyur pa lags te/ gtsug lag khang gi bdag po dang*/ gtsug lag khang gi lha rnams kyi slad du zhal nas gsungs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa re klag tu gsol// ces mdo bskul gzhung bzhin zhu/ de nas thams cad bzhengs nas gzan zlum khyer mdzad nas thal mo sbyar bzhin/ mkhan pos bskul te/ bcom ldan 'das sogs dal bus gdon/ de nas mkhan pos 'go bskul bcas/ gang tshe rkang gnyis sogs rang gdangs kyis rkang pa bzhi pa'i/ de tshe zhes pa'i skabs kun kyis thal mo spyi bor sbyar/ mkhas pa zhes pa'i skabs thal sbyar mgrin pa/ khyod la zhes pa'i skabs su snying gar thal mo sbyar/ phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa'i dus na ma lnga sa la gtug pa'i phyag bya ba ste snga phyi med par bsgrigs par bya ba ni/ 'og ma gdangs can thams cad la rigs 'gre'o//

tshigs bcad gsum rdzogs nas/ slar yang bskul te/ mgon po thugs rje= sogs rkang pa bzhi bar snga ma las brel tsam gyis thal sbyar gnas gsum bya/ sho lo ka gsum rdzogs pa dang*/ ji snyed su dag= lhug 'don dal zhing 'grigs pa la gzan gyi sne khug 'dzin gyin/ tshig rkang pa dang po la spyi bor/ gnyis pa la mgrin par/ gsum pa la snying gar thal mo sbyar/ rkang pa bzhi pa la ma lnga phab pas phyag bya ba ste/ yan lag bdun ka la (507) 'gre/ de yan gyi phyag 'tshal ba'i rgyud do// de nas thams cad bzhengs bzhin stod g.yogs zlum khyer dang sor bsnol gyi/ mkhan pos bskul te/ 'phags pa dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ nas mngon par bstod do// bar sher snying dang*/ de nas mkhan pos se gol dang bcas/ dge bar gsungs shig ces brjod/ sdebs 'don gyis/ skar ma rab rib= chos rnams thams cad rgyu= sogs/ de ni mdo 'don pa'i rgyud do/ / de nas bsod nams 'di yis sogs dang*/ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sogs/ klu rgyal dga'o sogs brjod/ de ni bsngo ba'i rgyud do/ / gtan du= brjod pa dang mnyam du thams cad tsog pur bzhugs/ phyag g.yon chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya skyabs sbyin gyi tshul dang g.yas pus steng mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad de/ rang rang gi sogs/ a ka ro= lan gsum dang*/ mjug gi khā hi zhes pa rnams la lag g.yas mdun du bskor nas/ phyir bkan te se gol brdeb par bya'o// de nas sor bsnol gyis/ 'jig rten bde zhing sogs rkang pa gsum gyi dus su gzan phrag tu 'phen/ bzhi pa'i dus su gding ba'i khug sne gnyis nas 'dzin/ dge skos nas sngar ltar phyag dang bcas te/ bstan pa rin po che'i rtsa lag dam par gyur pa don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te mkhan po thub bstan=(508)zhes bgyi ba gsan du gsol/ deng dus bzang la bdag cag 'dir 'dus shing tshogs pa rnams la thugs brtse bas nye bar dgongs te ston pa'i bka'i chos nyan par sbyin du gsol/

zhes chos 'chad par bskul/ de nas mdo 'don pa po seng ge'i khri la 'dzegs te/ gding ba nyis lteb tshal bu kha mdun du phyogs pa'i khar bzhugs/ dge 'dun rnams kyang gding lteb tshal bu'i kha mdun bstan/ dras kha g.yon gyi steng du pus btsugs dang sor bsnol gyis bzhugs/ de nas mkhan pos/ de yang slob dpaun sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i sogs stong thun gyi mtshams sbyar nas tshul khrims yang dag gi mdo gsungs/ de nas dbu mdzad kyis dal bus/ thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa'i skabs su thams cad bzhugs bzhin thal mo spyi bor sbyar te mdun du 'dud pa ma lnga sa la phab par bya zhing*/ de min thal mo bsnol te 'khod/ mjug gi chos bshad pa las= tshig rkang dang po 'di skabs thob kyis kha bsgyur la tshig bcu po bsdeb 'don bya/ skabs 'dir/ ja) btang*/ ja mchod/ 'jig rten mchod 'os dang*/ dus gsum sangs rgyas gnyis res mos mdzad/ 'jig rten mchod 'os yin na/ thub dbang rgyal ba zhes pa'i skabs dang*/ dus gsum sangs rgyas yin na/

hrīḥ bla ma yi dam= zhes pa'i dus tsam nas dge skos kyis rang gral de nyid du gding (509) ba ring bting gi khar phyag gsum 'tshal/ gzan gal khyer rkang lag 'dud rgya dang bcas/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ de ring gi tshe mang ja gnang bar 'os pa rnams la gnang bar thugs rjes 'dzin par zhu/ brjod/ dbu mdzad sogs 'dus pa byings nas/ ci bder longs spyod/ ces lan byin/ gsol zhal bzed pa'i tshe yang mthar chags su bzed pa dang*/ len pa'i tshe yang mthar chags su len/ mkhan pos zhal bkod dang*/ chos bshad sogs dgos na gong gi tshul khrims rnam dag mdo las 'phros nas gnang*/ chab dang bzed zhal phul/ de nas dge tshul rnams kyang bslab gral gyi go rim ma 'chol bar dang po gsum mkhan po'i mdun dang*/ de 'phros rnams dge slong rgan rim bzhin ma 'chol bar re re'i mdun du dge tshul gsum re gnas pa'i/ dang po bslab pa rgan pa mkhan po'i mdun du gnas pa rnams dang bsgrigs te phyag dang phyir bcos gso sbyong rnams bya zhing*/ dge slong rnams gding ba bcas zhal phyogs te tshul bzhin du lan gdab/ de zin pa dang*/ dge tshul rnams phyir bkar ba dang mjal mi sogs kyang phyir bskrad sgo glegs kyang bsdom par bya zhing*/ dge tshul rnams kyang ca co dang ga zha sogs med par lhod chags par 'khod/ de nas mkhan pos ltung thun byin rlabs dang*/ gnas la blo mthun rnams bya'o// de yan chad kyi sbyor ba'i (510) chos rnams so/ / gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ so so thar pa'i mdo bton nas yang dag gi dri ba nyid yin te/ de yang mkhan pos so so thar pa la sogs kyis 'du shes gsum gsal btab nas nyan par gdams te/ rab tu zhi ba'i tshul gyis/ rgya gar skad du sogs brjod/ de nas dbu mdzad kyi dal bus/ thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa'i skabs su kun kyis thal mo sbyar te mdun du gus par byas la bsdeb 'don bya/

de nas mkhan pos mchod brjod rnams kyi dus su thal mo sbyar zhing*/ 'phags pa'i tshogs kyi dbus su dbye bar bya/ zhes pa nas thal mo bsnol te mdo'i che ba brjod/ dus brjod tshul dpe'u ris ltar bya/ bslab pa bsrung ba'i thabs bag yod par gdams par bya ba rnams dang*/ 'dun dag dri ba yan chad legs par bya/ dge slong nad pa dang*/ dge sbyor gyi bya bas dus 'da' ba sogs chos ldan gyi bya bas g.yengs te 'du bar mi nus pa rnams las 'dun pa len dgos pa yod na/ dge skos sogs gang yang rung bas/ sngar dung brda' btang ba'i dus nas 'dun pa blangs te/ skabs 'dir rang gral nas gding ba ring bting khar phyag gsum dang rkang lag 'dud pa bcas/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams= sogs/ sgra dag lhag chad med par brjod/ de nas gding ba bltab ste rang gral du bzhugs zin nas/ mkhan pos/ shākya seng ge de la ni=(511) sogs nas gleng gzhi tsam dang*/ pham pa dang*/ lhag ma dang*/ ma nges pa'i chos gnyis la mtshams bar bton nas lhag ma thos par bsgrags pa dang*/ ril gyi 'don pa dang bcas rgyas bsdus lnga po ji ltar 'os pa 'don par bya'o// (dbyar gnas skabs gso sbyong gang rung zhig la mdo ril 'don dgos/ ril 'don gyi mkhan pos/ 'dus ma byas pa thob par gyis// zhes pa'i bar tshogs pa byings nas/ brtsam par bya zhing dbyung bar bya// zhes pa nas/ thub dbang go 'phang thob par shog / bar brjod pa yin/ mchan/) de ni dngos gzhi'o// mjug tu/ so sor thar pa bton pa yis// sogs tshigs bcad lnga po thams cad gyis bsdeb 'don bya'o// de nas rjes kyi bya ba ni/ dge tshul rnams kyang nang du 'khod de/ mkhan pos thal sbyar dang bcas/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas sogs rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa thams cad deng 'dir dgongs su gsol/ 'og tu dbyar gnas dgag dbye sogs bsngo smon nam gsung dgos dus dgongs gsol 'di kho na'o//

dge 'dun spyi nas kyang*/ dgongs su gsol/ zhes pa de mthun 'gyur dang bcas brjod de/ mkhan pos bskul nas/ 'jam dpal dpa' bos= sogs dang*/ dus gsum gshegs pa sogs shwo lo ka gnyis/ rin chen dge tshogs sogs/ sangs rgyas bstan pa sogs/ (512)gang du skyes pa'i sogs/ phan bde'i 'byung gnas sogs brjod/ de ltar 'grub par byed pa'ang sogs brjod/ de nas byang 'dren pas bskul te/ rgyal ba kun kyi= sa la 'og min= thub bstan mdzes pa'i= snga 'gyur bstan pa= bkra shis phan bde'i= bkra shis rgyal ba= snang grags rig gsum= skye ba kun tu= skar ma rab rib kyis tshogs grol/ de nas thams cad kyis bla gos gsol bzhin pa dang*/ snam sbyar phrag tu bkal/ gding ba lag tu thogs te/ ser sbrengs spos bsu bcas dal bus btang nas g.yas phyogs su thub dbang sku gzugs la bskor te/ de nas phyi rol du gtsug lag khang la g.yas (mi re'i bar du 'dom gang re tsam yod par byas nas phebs/) phyogs su bskor ba byas te grol dgos/ tshogs pa che dus rgya gling yang spros par bya'o// dge 'dun du ma longs ba rnams kyis ji ltar bya ba'i tshul ni gzhung nas ji skad bstan pa ltar ro// de ni gso sbyong ji ltar bya ba'i rim pa'o/// /
